data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts the harness 'requires structural revision,' but it provides no commitments and no evidence that any specific critic was incorrectly judged by the §11.3 flagging criterion. It presents a bare architectural objection ('conflates failed-on-X with unreliable') as an asserted fact without a premise or supporting quote, so the audit of the adjudication-ritual cannot sustain the claimed fault against this target as stated.
